meta.name: ai-image-generation
meta.description: Generate AI images with GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve and 50+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2, FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA, Gemini 3 Pro Image, Grok Imagine, Seedream 4.5, Reve, ImagineArt. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, text rendering. Use for: AI art, product mockups, concept art, social media graphics, marketing visuals, illustrations. Triggers: flux, image generation, ai image, text to image, stable diffusion, generate image, ai art, midjourney alternative, dall-e alternative, text2img, t2i, image generator, ai picture, create image with ai, generative ai, ai illustration, grok image, gemini image, gpt image, openai image, chatgpt image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一句话或一张图,把它变成想要风格的精修图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果身边没有设计师,却经常需要快速产出图片素材
copy.tagline_en: Turn a prompt or a photo into the finished image you want
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need ready-to-use images fast without a design team.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行调用 50+ 图像模型出图，可选 GPT-Image-2、FLUX、Gemini 等，支持文生图、图生图、修图、放大，也能做海报文字、产品图、插画等。
howto.when: 当你提到“flux”、“image generation”、“ai art”等关键词，或要求文生图、修图、放大时触发。使用前需先安装并登录 belt CLI。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张太空里的猫宇航员
把这张图 https://... 的背景换成日落海滩
say.note: 走 GPT-Image-2 做图像编辑

say.text: 用 Seedream 4.5 出一张 4K 电影感女性肖像

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates images by running 50+ models via the inference.sh belt CLI, e.g. GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini. It supports text-to-image, image-to-image, editing and upscaling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "flux", "image generation", "ai art" and similar keywords, or ask for text-to-image, editing or upscaling. Requires installing and logging into the belt CLI first.

say_en.text: Use FLUX to generate a cat astronaut in space
Change the background of this image to a beach at sunset
Make a 4K cinematic portrait with Seedream 4.5
